answer.reason: ParseFromString supports an uncolored OBJ vertex with vertex_color=false and no fallback colors. The old harness always passes a default configuration with vertex_color=true, so input bytes cannot reach that behavior. The same blocker exists before and after the source change.
answer.finite_witness: Input bytes: 76 20 30 20 30 20 30 0a 00 78, representing OBJ text "v 0 0 0\n", a NUL separator, and MTL text "x". With the supported setup config.vertex_color=false, parsing succeeds and colors remain empty. The harness instead passes vertex_color=true.

scope_contract.reason: The target calls ParseFromString on OBJ text. Its configuration contract exposes vertex_color=false, and the called loader uses that setting for vertex color fallback.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite NUL-separated input supplies a valid uncolored OBJ vertex. The parser recognizes its absent RGB components, and a supported false configuration selects the no-fallback behavior that the target setup blocks.

observable_consequence.reason: With fallback disabled, the loader leaves colors empty for the uncolored vertex. With the harness's default true setting, it supplies fallback color components instead. The supported no-fallback result is unreachable.

evidence.quote:

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete harness constructs one default configuration, never changes it, and makes one ParseFromString call. The supplied earlier uncertainty about the default is resolved by the before and after constructors: both set vertex_color=true. OBJ or MTL bytes cannot select false through this call sequence.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—ParseFromString, an uncolored vertex, vertex_color=false, and absent fallback colors—is supported in both versions and blocked by the same unchanged harness configuration.

coverage_witness.required_setup: Pass an ObjReaderConfig with vertex_color=false and an OBJ string containing an uncolored vertex.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness passes a default ObjReaderConfig whose vertex_color is true.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The harness cannot reach successful parsing of an uncolored vertex with fallback colors absent under vertex_color=false.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete supplied harness: input bytes supply only OBJ and MTL text, while the single call forwards the unchanged default configuration.
